A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (2 March 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Endor-L-endorscouttrooper-PC-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Endor Scout Trooper]]: The game text changes: “Endor Scout Trooper” becomes “this character”. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
